findings.issue: Upstream fetch has no timeout/AbortSignal, and withSlot (line 17) holds one of 32 concurrency slots for the whole await, so a hanging API server queues every subsequent request indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Pass AbortSignal.timeout(10_000) to fetch so a slow upstream fails fast instead of deadlocking the server

findings.issue: Any non-OK API response rejects into Astro's default error page; no page has a try/catch, no retry, no custom 500 page
findings.suggestion: Catch transport errors in the data layer (or add src/pages/500.astro) and surface a friendly error page with a retry link

findings.issue: security.checkOrigin: false disables Astro's default CSRF protection although the only form is method="get" and never triggers it

Ignores Astro 7's stable route caching (cache: { provider: memoryCache() }, routeRules, Astro.cache, added astro@7.0.0), which would give the expensive on-demand pages (1025-card home, move tables) SWR semantics natively
findings.suggestion: Enable memoryCache() and set routeRules for the list routes; keep the data-layer cache or fold it in

findings.issue: let page: any plus ~10 any casts; the api<T> generic (app/src/lib/api.ts:40) is never used and tsconfig extends astro/tsconfigs/base, so none of the template's property accesses are checked
findings.suggestion: Extend astro/tsconfigs/strict and give the hot paths (species, pokemon, move) minimal typed records

findings.issue: Fetch → DOMParser → replaceWith enhancement with a latest-counter race guard is duplicated in app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:223
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared swapRegion(url, selector) helper into src/scripts/

findings.issue: Rebuilds the type-name→label Map inline although lib/pokedex.ts:53 exports typeLabels() for exactly this; app/src/pages/types/[name].astro:23 does the same
findings.suggestion: Use (or return from getSpeciesIndex) the existing helper instead of three divergent copies

findings.issue: Failed background revalidation is silently swallowed, leaving the entry stale forever with no observability
findings.suggestion: Log the failure (or surface it via Astro's logger) so a broken upstream is visible
Delete them or use them where the markup currently inlines list-style: none

findings.issue: No unit tests for the pure helpers (humanize, dexNumber, compareMethods, latestFlavorText, cardsForPokemon) that carry the spec's trickiest edge cases (whitespace collapse, method ordering, missing-value sorting in src/scripts/sortable.ts)
findings.suggestion: Add a lightweight runner for these pure functions so future refactors of the cache don't need the Playwright suite to catch regressions

summary: A careful, current-Astro implementation: right architecture for the spec, correct 404/filter/sort/missing-value behaviour, clean transport-vs-domain layering and thoughtful progressive enhancement. The merge blockers are transport robustness — no fetch timeout behind a 32-slot semaphore and no error boundary — plus pervasive any typing. One round of changes and I'd merge it.
